name: GoodHub
shortDescription: A UK fundraising service for charities, with online donations, ticketing and Gift Aid collection.
suitableContexts: Churches collecting online donations and Gift Aid
Churches selling tickets for paid events or fundraising activities
Charities wanting a general fundraising provider rather than a church-management system

pricing.summary: GoodHub says it charges no registration, subscription or platform fee for fundraising and ticketing. It publishes a payment-processing fee of 1.9% + 20p per donation and a Gift Aid processing fee of 5% of Gift Aid, alongside an optional supporter contribution.

tiers.label: Fundraising and tickets
tiers.detail: Published payment-processing fee; Gift Aid processing is stated as 5% of Gift Aid

pricing.trialDetails: No general product trial was found in the public material reviewed.

gdprInformation: GoodHub publishes organisation and user terms that address personal information and charity responsibilities. Churches should review the applicable privacy policy, Gift Aid arrangements, donor-data access and export options before adoption.

gift-aid.value: Supplier terms say GoodHub Platforms Limited reclaims Gift Aid on behalf of a charity where the donor confirms UK taxpayer status.

data-processing.value: Organisation terms set out responsibilities for personal information processed through the service.

fees.value: Supplier publishes no registration, subscription or platform fee, plus 1.9% + 20p payment processing and a 5% Gift Aid processing fee.

editorial.assessment: GoodHub is a general UK charity fundraising platform, not a church-management database. It may suit a church needing online donations, Gift Aid and event ticketing without a subscription, provided the organisation is comfortable with its transaction and Gift Aid fee model. Finance teams should model those fees and reconcile the payout process before switching.
bestFor: Churches using online fundraising and occasional paid events
Charities wanting a no-subscription giving platform
Teams needing Gift Aid collection alongside ticket sales
strengths: Named active UK operator and public organisation terms
Published no-subscription model, payment fee and Gift Aid fee
Donation, ticketing and Gift Aid workflows are described
limitations: Not designed as a church people, rota or website-management platform
Gift Aid processing fee should be included in total-cost calculations
Confirm payout timing, exports, supporter-data access and the exact privacy documents for the selected service

procurementVerdict.problem: Collecting donations, event income and Gift Aid across multiple tools
procurementVerdict.differentiator: General charity fundraising and ticketing with no stated subscription fee
procurementVerdict.firstCheck: Model a representative donation, Gift Aid claim and paid-event ticket sale from donor payment through to payout

externalReviews.note: This company-level profile is for GoodHub and does not establish suitability for a particular church.
